item_short_desc: Durable and easy-to-use, Rothco’s Side Release Buckle is a widely used piece of hardware that can be added to any 3/8" webbing strap, from backpacks, paracord, belts, and more.
description: Durable and easy-to-use, Rothco’s Side Release Buckle is a widely used piece of hardware that can be added to any 3/8" webbing strap, from backpacks, paracord, belts, and more. Designed with contoured buckle sides to allow for a comfortable fit.  Easily adjust the webbing through the single-side bracket. Great for replacing already existing or missing buckles.
